title: feat: add qwen/qwen-image-2.1 via fal
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `qwen/qwen-image-2.1` (Alibaba Qwen Image 2.1) via fal, paid-only, no aliases. Text-to-image and editing with up to 10 reference images.
- Routes to `alibaba/qwen-image-2.1/text-to-image`, or `/edit` when reference images are supplied.
- No fallback: Replicate has `qwen/qwen-image-2`, but it is a different version, not 2.1.

### Maintainer follow-up
- **One fal Qwen handler**: `falQwenImageModel.ts` serves both Qwen Image 2.1 and the Qwen Image 3 fal fallback from one table (replaces `qwenImage3Model.ts`).
- **Aspect ratios**: without explicit dimensions, `aspectRatio` keeps the default ~1 MP area (16:9 → 1376×768, 21:9 → 1568×672), for both models. Explicit sizes pass through as before.
- **Qwen 3 2K boundary**: 2K above 2,250,000 px, as DashScope bills it (was 1536×1536, which underbilled requests in between).
- **Edits send `guidance_scale` 4**: fal's default of no guidance leaves edits noisy. Guidance doubles fal's edit price.
- **Billing from fal's count**: gen reads `x-fal-billable-units` (helper from #15454) and computes no sizes itself. Rates are fal's unit prices: $0.02 per MP for generation and $0.11/3 per MP for edits. Usage is whole millionths of a MP, which fits the UInt32 columns.
- **Safety**: fal's safety checker is off on both fal Qwen routes. Bedrock Guardrails is the safety system (#15441).

### Verification
- Staging E2E on 2ad8e468a7: a 1024² generation billed 1 MP ($0.02) and a one-reference edit billed 3 MP ($0.11). Tinybird, the wallet debit and fal's usage API all agree.

Fixes #15314

gist.headline: Qwen gets a bigger canvas
gist.blurb: Qwen Image 2.1 has landed through fal, with a proper editing desk for up to ten reference images. Polli checked the billable pixels too, because apparently pixels now require accounting.
gist.summary: Added paid-only Alibaba Qwen Image 2.1 via fal for text-to-image and reference-guided editing with up to 10 images, routing generations to `alibaba/qwen-image-2.1/text-to-image` and edits to `/edit` with fal-reported usage billing.
gist.impact: Developers can generate with Qwen Image 2.1 or make guided edits from up to 10 references, while 1024×1024 generations bill as 1 MP ($0.02) and one-reference edits as 3 MP ($0.11) using fal's billable-unit count.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy image-making garden studio represents Qwen Image 2.1: Polli tends a large framed pixel illustration while ten small reference-image cards feed into a friendly retro art terminal. A labeled text-to-image path and an edit path meet at the same glowing Qwen workstation, visually showing generation and multi-reference editing; tiny pixel flowers and code-plants keep it part of the hive.
